rationale: A unanimous, technical statutory-interpretation decision with a narrow, context-sensitive reading of “entitled to SSI benefits” makes the Chief Justice or Justice Barrett/Kagan the most likely majority authors, with Roberts favored to keep the opinion restrained and avoid broad trans-substantive definitions. Any separate writing is most likely a concurrence (Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch) emphasizing textualism/original meaning and Duke Energy-style context dependence, or a brief pragmatic concurrence (Sotomayor/Jackson) noting proxy/policy concerns while agreeing the text controls.
